audience: Australian online merchants who ship parcels with carriers through Shippit

useCases.title: Compare shipping quotes for a parcel
useCases.text: The AI asks your enabled carriers for a price and delivery estimate for a destination and parcel size. It can show every carrier. Nothing is booked.

useCases.title: Track an order and get the public tracking link
useCases.text: The AI reads the status history of an order by tracking number and the tracking page URL to give to the recipient.

useCases.title: Review account settings and tracking webhooks
useCases.text: The AI reads the merchant account, store operating hours, and the tracking webhooks with the order states that trigger them.

useCases.title: Create orders, label them and book pickup
useCases.text: The AI creates a domestic order, labels it to fix carrier and price, then books labelled orders with carriers for pickup. Labels and manifests come back as PDF links.

useCases.title: Cancel an order
useCases.text: The AI cancels an order by tracking number. A cancelled order cannot be revived.
